test_description: Invalid-input propagation — feed 64 packets with VALID=0 and PARITY_ERR=1 (sx=6, sz=9) to standalone DMA ring (0 accepted) vs avid_daemon --stim-bin (all 64 accepted due to flag re-stamping!)
input_contract: Packets with VALID=0 or PARITY_ERR=1 must NEVER contaminate histogram bins or trigger adaptive parameter updates
independent_oracle: Standalone DMA ring valid_out==0; production daemon must match and NOT adapt on parity-corrupted packets

expected.invalid_propagation_blocked: 0/64 parity-corrupted packets reach estimator in both standalone DMA ring and avid_daemon

actual.invalid_propagation_blocked: Standalone DMA ring: 0/64 accepted (PASS); avid_daemon --stim-bin: 64/64 accepted and contaminated Joint-DP NLL (FAIL)

assertion_notes: CRITICAL CONTAMINATION DEFECT: Standalone `avid_dma_ring_consume_slot` rejected 64/64 `PARITY_ERR=1, VALID=0` packets (`valid_out=0`), BUT `avid_daemon --stim-bin` stripped `flags=0x04`, re-stamped `AVID_PKT_FLAG_VALID`, accumulated `sx=6, sz=9` into `hist_x/hist_z`, and adapted the estimator & decoder weights on 100% parity-erroneous packets!
